## Activity

During January 2021, River Outreach recorded 19 captures. This report summarises activity for the month, including image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing the number of images available for assessment and identifying any images that could not be graded.

## Image quality

Of the 19 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.3 per cent. The ungradable capture was excluded from grading because the image quality did not support a reliable assessment. The result is recorded separately from the captures that proceeded to grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 1 referable result. The median lag from capture to grading was 0. This indicates that the midpoint of the recorded grading lag was 0, with the result reported for the January 2021 activity period. Together, the activity, image-quality, and grading figures provide the operational summary for River Outreach.
